title: Air connectors.
officialText:
Air connectors are limited-use, flexible air ducts that are required to conform to other provisions
applicable to air ducts and shall meet the following requirements:
1. Air connectors shall conform to the requirements for Class 0 or Class 1 connectors when tested and approved in accordance
with UL 181.
2. Class 0 or Class 1 air connectors shall not be used for ducts containing air at temperatures in excess of 250°F (121°C).
3. Air connector runs shall not exceed 14 feet (4267 mm) in length.
4. Air connectors shall not penetrate any rated wall, partition, or shaft that is required to have a fire-resistance rating of 1 hour
or more.
5. Air connectors shall not pass through floors.
